Projects

Research studies, software, and robotic systems for understanding and responding to robot failures.

Research studies Software & robotic systems

Research studies

Gaze & behavioural sensing · HRI 2025

Gaze-Based Robot Failure Detection

Investigating how gaze changes when a robot makes a mistake, and whether those changes can support early failure detection during collaborative tasks.

Project detailsRelated paper

Trust & failure awareness · CHI 2026

Trust Dynamics Across Multiple Robot Failures

Examining how repeated robot failures affect trust, and when a robot's awareness of its mistakes helps people continue working with it.

Project detailsRelated paper

Software & robotic systems

Failure detection & recovery in simulation

Ongoing research · NVIDIA Isaac · Vision–language models

Developing a simulation-based framework that combines behaviour trees with vision–language model reasoning to detect robot failures and select recovery strategies.

ROSAnnotator

Research software · HRI 2025

A web application for annotating and analysing ROSBag data in human–robot interaction. I supervised the master's project behind its development.

About the project

OfficeMate

Office assistant robot · TIAGo / ROS · HRI 2025

A social office assistant combining conversation, person-following, autonomous navigation, and activities such as snack handovers and breathing exercises. A seven-participant office pilot explored its potential to support well-being, alongside concerns about privacy, noise, communication, and interaction timing.
